correctness.rationale: All closed factors of a four-run word are exhaustively partitioned into one-run powers, no two-run factors, three-run palindromic returns, and four-run first returns across the two 01 transitions. Each class is explicitly parameterized, disjoint and counted; the sum simplifies to n+1+min(a,c)min(b,d). Integer product maximization proves the sharp bound and equality classification, and the pair-minimum series proves the generating functions. The standalone checker independently tests all parameter compositions to length 16 and longer samples with two definition-level closedness algorithms, and agrees.

value.rationale: Four runs are the first binary linear run class outside the bitonic/CR-poor regime and the very class used for quadratic closed-factor lower-bound constructions in the 2013 foundational literature. Exact all-length parameter classification, sharp leading coefficient, full equality-case counts and an enumerative generating function answer natural unresolved refinements of that construction, not a renamed textbook exercise or a lone numerical case. They also place this class rigorously below the published unrestricted asymptotic n²/6.
